title: UTF-8 bytes
description:
Show how characters become bytes in UTF-8.

```
Text: Aé€😀
A   U+0041   1 byte:  41
é   U+00E9   2 bytes: C3 A9
€   U+20AC   3 bytes: E2 82 AC
😀  U+1F600  4 bytes: F0 9F 98 80
4 characters, 10 bytes
```
hints: `" ".join(f"{b:02X}" for b in ch.encode("utf-8"))` prints the bytes.
requirements: For each character, print its code point (`ord`) and its UTF-8 bytes (`ch.encode("utf-8")`) in hex.
Print the totals of characters and bytes.
stretch: Decode bytes back by hand: read the first byte's leading 1s to know how many bytes follow.
